title: Compute split quality metrics per project for the quality panel
acceptance: A Split quality panel per project shows overhead ratio, first-try pass rate, critical path, wave fill, collisions, review $ per ticket and ticket sizes, each green, amber or red.

title: Merge board snapshots from multiple machines into one federated board feed
acceptance: Projects and orchestrators from the MacBook and the Mac mini appear on one board.

title: Render the Split quality panel with green, amber and red metrics per project
acceptance: A Split quality panel per project shows overhead ratio, first-try pass rate, critical path, wave fill, collisions, review $ per ticket and ticket sizes, each green, amber or red.

title: Show machine and swarm version on cards and flag version drift
acceptance: Each card shows its machine and swarm version, and version drift is flagged.

title: Push scanned field exports between swarm machines
acceptance: Field push transfers only metadata bundles that passed secret and PII scanning.

title: Replay tests for ticket manager scope gate and unblocker replan report
acceptance: The Ticket Manager keeps at least 5 ready tickets per active project.
The Unblocker re-plans blocked tickets (R-013) and reports what it changed.
The re-plan is logged with its reason.
